goal: 用已录制协议实现两个只读审核适配器，离线假 CLI 验证完整生命周期。

interface_contracts.name: runtime API
interface_contracts.definition: runtime.RuntimeAdapter(provider:str, *, executable:str|None=None, timeout:float=180, grace:float=2, log_dir:Path, output_schema:dict|None=None) implements existing Adapter; provider codex|claude. Fresh process/session per turn; only Permission.READ_ONLY. check_environment explicit separate local version/auth/model checks. Completed.result contains parsed structured output JSON, no requested model/effort copied to evidence. Raw unknown events and process exit retained in external log_dir. output_schema optional lets caller pass report schema without module dependency.

interface_contracts.name: boundary
interface_contracts.definition: Use runtime-protocols and local snapshots, no real CLI calls during implementation/tests (version/help allowed only to check protocol version). Claude removes ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, safe-mode+Read,Grep,Glob+no persistence. Codex read-only sandbox never approvals, ephemeral, new temp cwd supplied by caller; application/user custom instruction/MCP isolation limitations documented, never claim more than verified. Handle errors timeout/auth/model/rate/cancel, malformed JSON/early exit Error(category=None). Preserve raw events. Terminal and process exit separate; no synthetic reported metadata. Cancellation cleanup after bounded grace.
